# ThryveX Group

> ThryveX Group is an AI automation and web development agency that builds always-on systems which capture leads, qualify prospects, automate follow-up, and help modern businesses scale without limits.

## What we do
- **AI Automation** — CRM automations, lead follow-up systems, AI front desk, intake workflows, and AI agents that respond instantly across WhatsApp, SMS, email and voice.
- **Website Development** — custom, fast, animated, conversion-focused websites.
- **AI Chatbots** — AI agents that qualify leads and reply 24/7.
- **Meta Ads** — lead-generation ad campaigns that fill the pipeline.

## Who it's for
Businesses that are losing leads to slow follow-up, manual admin, and disconnected tools — and want one connected, intelligent system that runs without them.

## How it works
A structured, hands-on process: Discovery & Audit, Strategy & Blueprint, Build & Integrate, then Launch & Optimize. We turn existing tools and workflows into a connected, automated system.
